prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic full-body portrait of one original approved adult businesswoman in a deep navy suit against a monochromatic navy studio background.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with a calm professional smile, natural skin texture and polished shoulder-length dark hair. She wears a deep navy slim-fit suit, crisp white shirt, patterned tie and black dress shoes, standing with hands in pockets.
composition_elements: Full-body centered portrait with upright professional stance and feet clearly visible.
Smooth monochromatic navy background with clean negative space.
Preserve suit tailoring, white shirt, tie pattern, shoes, relaxed hands and executive presence.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft cinematic side light with controlled dramatic shadows, subtle rim separation and refined navy tonal contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 full-body portrait, 35mm lens at f/5.6, wide-angle editorial framing without distortion, realistic suit weave, skin and shoe texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
